name: COUNTRYSIDE FAMILY FARMS / EL SID TAQUERIA

violations.text:
Bowl or other container with no handle used to dispense food.
In pepper. Employee removed

Wall soiled with accumulated grease, food debris, and/or dust.
Dust buildup on wall near ice cream machines

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rice observed at 51f. Sitting above chill line for 30 minutes. Manager moved to cooler to rapid chill

Food-contact surface soiled with food debris, mold-like substance or slime.
Can opener blade has old food debris. Employee moved to clean

No currently certified food service manager on duty with four or more employees engaged in food preparation/handling. A list of accredited food manager certification examination providers can be found at http://www.myfloridalicense.com/DBPR/hotels-restaurants/food-lodging/food-manager/
Spray bottle containing toxic substance not labeled. Glass cleaner

Nonfood-contact surface soiled with grease, food debris, dirt, slime or dust.
Grease buildup up on wall/shelf above flat top and between grill.
Gaskets on produce cooler
Wet wiping cloth not stored in sanitizing solution between uses.

Hot time/temperature control for safety food received at less than 135 degrees Fahrenheit.
ground beef (117F - Hot Holding); cooked steak (117F - Hot Holding) in steam table 1 hour. Advised to reheat

Proof of required state approved employee training not available for some employees. To order approved program food safety material, call DBPR contracted provider: Florida Restaurant and Lodging Association (SafeStaff) 866-372-7233.

Operator is utilizing ROP for smoked sausage and smoked pork butt
Cutting board has cut marks and is no longer cleanable.

No conspicuously located ambient air temperature thermometer in holding unit.
In frozen drink cooler
